extension.summary: NewPipe MOD — Original creator: Twilight0 | MOD: @TrainAgain2
extension.description: NewPipe MOD. Original creator and upstream: Twilight0 (https://github.com/Twilight0/plugin.video.newpipe). MOD: @TrainAgain2. This is a self-contained ZIP: no external Kodi repository or script.module add-on is required. Browse and watch YouTube without an account. Search, channels, playlists and local subscriptions stay on your device. Random Music uses a rotating, de-duplicated music-discovery mix rather than the Trending source. Optionally, sign in through the NewPipe MOD YouTube TV activation flow at yt.be/activate; a compact high-contrast QR stays fixed above the activation code and its live expiry countdown, while authorization checks and subscription synchronization happen automatically. Playback uses the bundled native engine to obtain one direct progressive audio/video stream, without a local proxy or plugin.video.youtube.
extension.disclaimer: This addon does not host or distribute any content; it only browses publicly available YouTube pages. Optional account linking stores its session token only in the local Kodi add-on profile.
